fields.description: Issue features editorials and reporting on local civic and business conditions following the Supreme Court decision ending the NRA, including calls for voluntary maintenance of wages and hours. Prominent coverage condemns illegal marble board gambling operations in downtown Miami, alleging racketeering and lack of enforcement, and discusses the scale of the activity and its impact on the city. The issue also advocates organizing petitions to force a referendum to end dog racing in Dade County, includes political rumor items about state and local offices, and reports on Miami Beach municipal affairs including expected resignation of Mayor Louis A. Snedigar. Regular columns and local-interest pieces address sports and racing tips, nightlife/entertainment notices, and community commentary.
